research_scope.disposition: retain for diagnostics; do not freeze or promote unchanged

hypotheses: H1: the historical fidelity_mcts-labelled adaptive-planner path improves exploratory fixed-reference success-cost hypervolume over cheap-only and fixed-cascade paths
H2: at matched verifier success, describe paired normalized-cost and executable-call differences between the adaptive-planner path and accurate-only routing without a directional superiority claim
H3: discrepancy-aware routing improves paired success over uncertainty-threshold routing at matched budget
H4: historical absolute-discrepancy proxy stopping reduces normalized cost without a success loss larger than 0.05

benchmark.execution_engine: Python stdlib sqlite3 in-memory disposable clones with read-only authorizer and progress limits

training.router_target: absolute cheap-versus-verified discrepancy EVC proxy; explicitly not a causal value-of-compute target
training.split_policy: template-family-disjoint immutable fixtures; no exploratory or future-confirmatory outcome enters training

method_validity_notes.fidelity_mcts: historical identifier; this runner calls AdaptiveComputePlanner directly and does not execute an outer MCTS tree
method_validity_notes.oracle_counterfactual: budget-limited and candidate-order-sensitive; not guaranteed to be an upper bound
method_validity_notes.learned_direct: cheap-model-only learned predictor; not a query-level multi-model router

ablation_validity_notes.fidelity_no_discrepancy: still uses an updating RunningDiscrepancyModel and is not a true no-correction intervention
ablation_validity_notes.fidelity_no_verification: reduces to the same cheap-only route as fidelity_cheap_fidelity_only
ablation_validity_notes.fidelity_cheap_fidelity_only: reduces to the same cheap-only route as fidelity_no_verification
ablation_validity_notes.fidelity_no_tree_reuse: structurally inapplicable in this one-decision fixture

resource_accounting.normalized_cost_definition: model prediction=0.25; executable SQLite query=4.0; final task action reported separately and excluded from compute matching
resource_accounting.failed_execution_charge: retain full conservative reservation and record a negative verified failure outcome
resource_accounting.random_matching: exact randomized accurate-call quota estimated on calibration fixtures only

confirmatory_seed_policy.source: future externally timestamped randomness after user approval
confirmatory_seed_policy.generation_time: after final benchmark, method, budget, analysis, and artifact-hash approval
confirmatory_seed_policy.access_policy: no generation, inspection, or execution before freeze and external registration

analysis.interval_method: paired stratified bootstrap over task_id and paired_seed
analysis.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm within each primary confirmatory hypothesis family
estimands: average paired verifier-success difference at each budget
average paired normalized-cost difference at each budget
success-cost hypervolume difference over the full budget curve
diagnostic comparison of naive, IPS, SNIPS, and doubly robust estimates against randomized online pilot outcomes; not a confirmatory hypothesis
analysis.power_method: pilot-based paired variance diagnostic followed by a frozen sample-size decision before confirmatory materialization

sample_size_plan.unit: independent task or held-out template family; order permutations are repeated measurements
sample_size_plan.multiplicity_assumption: first-step Holm alpha 0.0125 for the H1-H4 family
sample_size_plan.caveat: The previous 32-pair calculation treated action-order permutations of four tasks as independent and its raw pilot lineage is not versioned here. Do not use it for a confirmatory sample-size decision.

failure_policy.retry_policy: no automatic retries; preserve and charge every failed or timed-out execution

exclusions: no result-dependent task, seed, method, endpoint, or budget exclusions
paired exclusion only for a preregistered infrastructure failure affecting all methods for the unit
SQL errors, verifier failures, deadline interrupts, and budget exhaustion remain reported outcomes

multiplicity_policy.ope: diagnostic reporting only; no confirmatory hypothesis or multiplicity-adjusted claim
multiplicity_policy.ablations: descriptive unless separately promoted before freeze

artifact_hash_policy.status: partial diagnostic hashes only; current map does not satisfy a freeze gate
required_before_any_future_freeze: dependency lock or exact built artifact
